title: Spatial visionOS glass window
blurb: Composite a 3D tilted HTML workspace panel over a procedural room in one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas with mipmapped Gaussian frost, Snell rim refraction, chromatic edge dispersion, pointer-tracked specular bevels and gaze button glow.
question: Can one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas composite a live 3D tilted HTML window with mipmapped Gaussian frost, Snell rim refraction, chromatic bevel dispersion, directional edge highlights and pointer-proximity button glow while keeping tilted controls clickable with updateElementGeometry()?
result: Measured in headless Chrome 160 Canary (2026-11-27, 412x915, 2.625 DPR): 6/6 live checks pass, 0.98 MP and 7.85 MB on one ElementGL context, 0 errors, specular bevel luminance swaps cleanly from TL (255 vs 91.3) to BR (145.5 vs 255), and elementsFromPoint() hits buttons under 3D tilt.
